tickets.title: Fork: a hidden tab opened for a look hides again when focus leaves it
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-26: opening a hidden tab (focus via tab.focus / pane.focus / agent.focus, or a click on the hidden count) should be a peek: when focus moves to another tab, the tab hides again. `tab.set_hidden {hidden:false}` stays an explicit pin that keeps it visible. Add a `peek` state to hidden tabs: focus on a hidden tab reveals it as peeked (tab.get/list report `hidden:false, peek:true`); leaving focus (another tab focused in that workspace, or the client switching workspace) restores `hidden:true` and clears peek; `tab.set_hidden` false clears peek (pinned), true hides. Peek is not persisted across cold restore (a peeked tab restores hidden); live-handoff carries it. Capability: `ping.capabilities.hidden_tabs_peek`. Document in HUD-FORK.md. Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud`; do not merge; never push or install.

acceptance.text: Tests: focus a hidden tab -> visible with peek; focus another tab -> hidden again; set_hidden false while peeked -> stays visible after focus leaves; set_hidden true hides; cold restore of a peeked tab -> hidden; live-handoff keeps peek
HUD-FORK.md updated; fmt, clippy -D warnings, schema check, unit tests single-threaded, api_ping, live_handoff, release build

tickets.title: Fork: right-edge non-modal dock (overlay and push, single-instance server toggle)
tickets.live_try: after install, `herdr dock toggle -- /usr/bin/env sh -c cat` opens a right-edge overlay without resizing the focused pane and a second call closes it
tickets.what: D-2026-11-26-01 Step 2a, fork side. Feasibility (oracle job jf92ac005aa757331, read its full report): the modal popup_pane cannot host it; owner 2026-11-26 approved the larger change (~650-850 non-test Rust LOC), sequenced after herdr-fork/21. Build Shape A (server-projected session dock): new fork modules src/dock.rs and src/app/dock.rs plus thin call sites; AppState.dock outside Workspace/Tab layout; one session-wide dock hosting one direct-exec argv command (agent detection disabled, HERDR_DOCK=1, pane identity env stripped); API dock.toggle / open / close / configure / status decided atomically in the server, CLI `herdr dock ...`, capability `dock` on ping. Overlay mode keeps tab pane rects and PTY sizes unchanged and composites the dock with a 1-cell left border over the right edge; push mode shrinks the tab area and emits pane.resized. Project the dock as pane id `dock` at PaneSurfaceFrame.panes[0] (scroll none; omitted from ClientShellSnapshot.panes and pane.list) for click focus, mouse and wheel forwarding, PaneFocus, PaneFocusDirection right into / left out of the dock, PaneClose(dock), PaneDied cleanup. Must coexist with Copy mode, Settings and popup_pane (hud.select-send opens over the dock without ui_busy). Preserve the dock PTY, mode and width across server.live_handoff; cold restore starts closed. Leave endpoint.surface-delta.v1 and the endpoint method-shape fixture unchanged. Document in HUD-FORK.md with the Apache-2.0 4(b) notices; regenerate the schema artifact. Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud` after 21 is merged; do not merge, push or install.

tickets.title: Fork: the agent sidebar groups panes by two metadata tokens, foldable
tickets.live_try: after install and HUD 27, workers of two projects and two features show as two big groups with small groups beneath; fold one and it stays folded after reattaching the client
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-26: the left sidebar should sort workers automatically into big groups (project) and small groups (task) that fold, so the logical relation is visible at a glance. Generic fork feature: when any agent pane's metadata tokens (pane.report_metadata, herdr-fork/19) carry `hud_group`, the expanded agent sidebar renders group header rows `▾ name N` (big) and, inside, `▾ name N` (small, from `hud_subgroup`, indented one cell), with the agent rows beneath in today's order; panes without `hud_group` stay ungrouped above the groups as today; panes with a group but no subgroup sit directly under the big group. A header shows the count and the strongest state colour of its hidden rows when folded. Click or Enter on a header folds/unfolds; fold state is a client preference keyed by group (and group/subgroup) name, kept across restarts like the worktree collapsed_groups, and pruned when a name has not been seen for 7 days. Without any hud_group token the sidebar is byte-identical to today. The collapsed (narrow) sidebar orders rows by group but draws no headers. Hit map, keyboard navigation and agent focus keep working across headers. Document in HUD-FORK.md. Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud`; do not merge, push or install.

▾ MyHUD            3

tickets.title: fork: the dock collapses and expands without stopping its process
tickets.live_try: After install, open /hud, scroll or select something in the panel, collapse it with the keybinding and with the frame button, then expand it: the panel reappears instantly with the same state, and the main pane uses the full width while collapsed.
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud (dispatch with cwd there; land via its own land block). D-2026-11-27-01. Today `dock.toggle`/`dock.close` shut the dock terminal down (src/app/dock.rs close_dock → shutdown_terminal_runtime), so reopening is a cold start. Add a hidden state: `dock.hide` / `dock.show` and `dock.toggle` switching between shown and hidden while a dock exists (open it if none); `dock.close` still stops it. Hidden: the runtime keeps running and keeps its size, nothing is drawn, the tab area is full width in both overlay and push mode, mouse and keys never route to it. `dock.status` / the response report `shown`, `hidden` and the existing fields; live-handoff carries hidden. Add a clickable collapse mark on the dock frame and a default keybinding (prefix-based, configurable like other herdr bindings) that toggles hidden/shown. Wire protocol stays additive (old clients ignore the new fields). Never touch ~/.local/bin/herdr or the running server; main installs.

tickets.title: fork: the dock resizes by dragging and docks to the right, left or bottom edge
tickets.live_try: After install, drag the dock's inner border to resize it, then switch the side to left and to bottom in HUD Settings; the width/height you dragged is kept after hide/show and after reopening.
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. D-2026-11-27-01. Width is only settable via `dock.configure` today, and the dock is fixed to the right edge (src/dock.rs inner_rect/tab_area). (a) Dragging the dock's inner border with the mouse resizes it (width for left/right, height for bottom), clamped so the main area keeps its current minimum; the drag emits a `dock.resized` event with the new size so HUD can persist it. (b) `DockOptions.side: right | left | bottom` (default right), applied live by `dock.configure`, in overlay and push; `size` stays meaningful per side (width for left/right, rows for bottom). Additive protocol; handoff carries side and size.
